in_marathi.name: Somasree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Somasree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Somasree is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Soma', which represents the God of the Moon and the source of all vitality, and 'Sree', which refers to the Goddess of Prosperity. Somasree is thus a name that symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and the divine blessings of the Moon God.

vedic_reference.note: Somasree is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, specifically from the name of the Moon Goddess, Sree. The name is a combination of 'Som' (Moon) and 'Sree' (Goddess of grace). In Hindu mythology, the Moon God is considered to be a symbol of the mind, and the Moon Goddess, Sree, is believed to be the embodiment of grace and fertility. Somasree is therefore a name that represents the grace and blessings of the Moon Goddess.
